The after-action review should compare the inject timeline with decisions, identify single points of failure, and assign owners for communications, staffing, telemetry, and backup control. This reproduces cascading disruption and public pressure for training while keeping all effects fictional and preventing an operational sabotage plan from being applied to a real city.
